name: examnotespdf-automation
description: Local-machine batch automation that calls the Claude or Gemini API directly (agentic NCERT-RAG + web search) to generate Long Post Factory articles for a whole topic list at once. Writes the same pending-long-posts/<slug>.json bundle shape the browser tool produces, so publish-long-post.yml picks it up unchanged. Provider chosen via AI_PROVIDER; only that provider's key is needed, read from the environment only — never committed. Run locally: see README.md.
